name: @pipobscure/napp
description: Archive and sign a set of files, verify the result, and mount it as a verifying node:vfs provider so only properly signed .napp archives run.
author: Philipp Dunkel <pip@pipobscure.com>

scripts.manifest:
NAPP_MANIFEST=app.manifest node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs -r ./lib/record.cjs --vfs-load --vfs-mount lib/ help > /dev/null && printf 'provider.js
register.cjs
recorder.js
record.cjs
' >> app.manifest
scripts.napp: node --no-warnings lib/app.js create --base lib/ --key certs/leaf.key --chain certs/chain.pem --files app.manifest --output app.napp
scripts.archive: node --no-warnings lib/app.js create --base lib/ --prefix shell-base --key certs/leaf.key --chain certs/chain.pem < app.manifest > app.run && chmod 0755 app.run
scripts.executable: node --no-warnings lib/app.js create --base lib/ --prefix node-base --key certs/leaf.key --chain certs/chain.pem < app.manifest > app.sea && chmod 0755 app.sea
